verdict.rationale: The docs include API code examples such as `client.runs.create(...)`, browser launch/CDP connect flows, and event polling, plus a machine-readable llms.txt, so some API reference material exists. However, nothing shows an interactive explorer or try-it console, and probes for an OpenAPI/Swagger spec all returned 404, so the interactive, runnable part of the story is unsupported. Missing for 10: interactive API explorer/playground, runnable in-browser examples, a published OpenAPI spec backing the reference, and independent hands-on corroboration.
